headline: No Close Games This Week, but demon44 Sits Brock Purdy's 28.2 and Loses by 53
meme_brief: A manager benches the guy who scores more than anyone else in his own lineup, then loses by more than fifty points anyway — the fantasy equivalent of forgetting your umbrella on the one day it actually rains inside your house.
recap:
No game was close in Week 11. The tightest finish was Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier's 128.70-109.08 win over LaHorrible, a 19.62-point margin, with Jared Goff's 24.36 leading Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier and C.J. Stroud's 27.46 and Cam Ward's 26.22 keeping LaHorrible within reach.

The week's biggest blowout was Kirkumcised Penix's 126.66-72.94 win over demon44, a 53.72-point margin. Travis Kelce led Kirkumcised Penix with 25.4, and demon44 started Daniel Jones (5.06) while Brock Purdy sat on the bench with 28.2, a 23.14-point gap that was the week's only real bench mistake.

Playing for 2027 beat The Josh Allens 159.82-111.4 behind Jonah Coleman's 32.9, a 48.42-point margin that matters for the sixth-seed race. Brent Looking 4 His Keys beat Theme From The Bottom 103.18-56.28 with Justin Herbert's 26.44 on top, while Fernando Mendoza's 29.88 was nearly all of Theme From The Bottom's offense. Full Chuba beat Silverbacks (100 vs 1) 140.2-105.5, and NateDawg726 beat mikelanta 140.9-105.4 behind Dak Prescott's 43.9, the league's top individual score.
transaction_desk:
The week's moves were mostly low-cost tinkering. Playing for 2027 spent a mid-tier priority slot (#8 of 12) on Ben Sinnott, who has not scored yet. Full Chuba spent slot #6 on Xavier Hutchinson, who shares an NFL team and position with Tank Dell on that roster, a sensible depth move that has produced 2.3 points so far. The Josh Allens picked up Emari Demercado as an uncontested free agent while cutting Carson Wentz; Demercado sits behind David Montgomery and has added 3.9 points.

Austin Ekeler changed hands: Theme From The Bottom, who had held him since Week 8, dropped him for Aidan O'Connell, and demon44 then claimed him on waivers from the #11 slot, which cost next to nothing. Ekeler has produced 5.4 points for demon44. Theme From The Bottom also swapped Samaje Perine for Gavin Bartholomew (1.5 points so far) later in the week, and Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier picked up the dropped Perine for free and has already collected 11.7 points from him, the best return of the week's adds.
trade_desk:
Two trades went through this week. Brent Looking 4 His Keys sent a 2028 third-round pick (originally mikelanta's) and a 2028 second-round pick (originally demon44's) to Playing for 2027 for Jordan Addison, age 24, and a 2028 fourth-round pick.

Our read: Playing for 2027 comes out ahead. Addison is a boom-or-bust Vikings receiver who, per reports, needs thumb surgery and could miss multiple weeks, with injured reserve possible, and he was already inactive for Week 10. Minnesota did pick up his fifth-year option, which keeps him under contract through 2027. The two picks come from teams currently 4-7, so they could land early in their rounds. Brent Looking 4 His Keys is 5-6 and 89.3 points behind the sixth seed, so paying for a hurt receiver is a long-term bet rather than a push for this season.

The second trade was a swap of picks between demon44 and mikelanta. demon44 sent a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 first-round pick and received a 2028 fifth, a 2027 first originally belonging to Full Chuba, and a 2028 second originally belonging to Theme From The Bottom.

Our read: close to even. demon44 moves up a round in 2027 and adds a 2028 second from a 1-10 team, which could land near the top of the round, in exchange for its own 2028 first. mikelanta is betting that a 2028 first is worth more than the two picks it gave up, and both teams are 4-7. Which side wins depends on where those 2028 picks end up. These are opinions rather than calculations, since no market values were used.

standings_narrative:
The race for the sixth and final playoff seed is the story of the bottom half. The Josh Allens hold it with 1305.38 season points. Playing for 2027 trails by 34.86 points, Kirkumcised Penix by 58.62 and Brent Looking 4 His Keys by 89.3. That is not a razor-thin gap, but it is less than one big week: Playing for 2027 outscored The Josh Allens by 48.42 points head to head on its own this week. The Josh Allens face LaHorrible next, while Playing for 2027 faces the top seed, Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier.

The top five seeds go by record. Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier is 9-2, NateDawg726 is 8-3 and Silverbacks (100 vs 1) is 7-4, with Full Chuba and LaHorrible both 6-5 in the last two spots. Playing for 2027 is 6-5 as well but sits behind them among the 6-5 teams on points, which is why it is chasing the points seed.
look_ahead: Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier, the league's top seed at 9-2, faces Playing for 2027, who sit at 6-5 and are fighting for ground in the sixth-seed points race. Brent Looking 4 His Keys and Silverbacks (100 vs 1) meet with records of 5-6 and 7-4 respectively. Theme From The Bottom, at 1-10, faces Full Chuba, who sit at 6-5 and hold the fourth seed. The Josh Allens, currently the sixth seed by points at 5-6, take on LaHorrible at 6-5. Kirkumcised Penix and mikelanta square off at 5-6 and 4-7. NateDawg726, at 8-3, plays demon44, who sit at 4-7.

running_jokes: Theme From The Bottom added yet another pair of free agents this week (an uncontested quarterback and tight end swap) while sitting at 1-10, continuing the volume approach without results so far.
demon44 benched a 28.2-point Brock Purdy for a 5.06-point Daniel Jones, the first time this specific mistake has shown up for that roster.

streaks.demon44: First documented bench mistake of this stretch — sat Brock Purdy's 28.2 points for Daniel Jones' 5.06.
streaks.Theme From The Bottom: Continuing heavy free-agent churn (two more moves this week) with a 1-10 record and still no bench-mistake streak active.
